directorDecision.source: GPT Director response in Calibration review part 6 after Return289
directorDecision.supersedesRequirement: MD196-B01's requirement to demonstrate an acquired, operational inserted-turn provider as a prerequisite for Mind Collapse acceptance. Preserve the historical finding unchanged.
directorDecision.ruling: The missing external provider is a conditional qualification rather than a whole-spell acceptance gate. Mind Collapse itself grants no turns. The bound combat rules distinguish inserted turns from regular clock markers; requiring another unresolved ability before accepting that distinction was an unnecessary dependency.

historicalFinding.historicalText: No exact acquired source granting a genuine full extra turn and complete legal actor had been bound for the positive branch; additional Actions and initiative movement were insufficient.
historicalFinding.currentDisposition: Superseded as a Mind Collapse acceptance prerequisite by MD290-OBLIGATION-REVISION-01; retained as historical evidence and as a conditional qualification for actual use of any external provider.

conditionalQualifications.text: Actual use of an external inserted-turn provider remains conditional on its separately authorized procedure, lawful acquisition, activation, recipient eligibility and history. This review grants no such ability.

procedureAmendment.text: An independently lawful inserted turn does not advance or replace Mind Collapse's three original regular-END markers. It supplies no additional Mind Collapse repeat save, duration decrement, regular-start recharge, Reaction refresh, Ready deadline or regular recovery tick. Stunned and Incapacitated remain operative throughout it. Any turn-local opportunities supplied by the external source remain subject to those conditions. Ending that inserted turn restores the interrupted scheduling context without restoring spent resources or ended effects.

counterspellClassCard.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve. This is gained automatically at Wizard 2 and is never also selected from the Arch pool.

classFamilyRules.firstDistinctFamily: PROTECTED DISSONANCE INTERFACE. The first cast of each different prepared matrix family during an encounter generates 0 BASE Dissonance. This exemption affects only base strain. Refrain and explicitly printed strain costs still apply; the suite disables generic Overcast and does not layer historical Burn onto Dissonance. Repeating a matrix family follows normal Refrain immediately. Preparing duplicates or differently modified copies of the same underlying spell never refreshes the exemption.
classFamilyRules.matrixAccounting: Core Systems V 2 Resonance Points and spell-rank RP costs are authoritative for Wizard spellcasting. There are no historical spell slots in this pilot. Wizard cards tagged wizard-spell are always-prepared class matrices once acquired, do not consume a daily prepared-matrix position and use the same RP, concentration, Refrain and protected first-distinct-matrix rules as other Wizard spells. Their printed RP cost replaces any generic rank cost; never pay both.
